motivation: Conservative text equivalence audit found 140 repeated descriptions in SportsMOT and33 in KITTI. Human observers reuse a visual judgement for equivalent requests, then spend saved attention on unseen objects or contradictions.
candidate_combination: semantic-class coverage rather than independent redundant query budgets
first broad image-feature scan, then additional view only for uncertain or contradictory evidence
classical view reliability fusion with shared-evidence mean/fixed-reliability controls
existing task protocol and image-only appearance regularization
query implication consistency under identical independent decoding
budget: Keep exactly the registered per-video image teacher call budget; a derived shared label is not a new real call. Extra language/model work and each multi-image view token/wall cost counted separately.
selection_firewall: Only already-requested replies enter acquisition; no reading hidden cached alternative answers. Broker cache may serve explicit requests, with cache/new forwards separately reported.
fairness: Ordinary learners get the identical actual new QA and visual information. Include original same-budget COVER KD, new-path direct raw distillation, new-path mean/DS teacher-label controls and full-component ablations; do not attribute all new teacher-quality gain to the final graph.
risk: Equivalent wording is a linguistic assumption; teacher outputs across views are correlated, DS unsupervised reliability is not guaranteed accuracy. C1 conservative equivalence currently has no duplicates, so acquisition savings there cannot be claimed.
execution_gate: Inspect new six-direction transfer and fixed query-consistency results, plus teacher-only actual duplication/contradiction counts, before fixing and executing the new acquisition recipe. No fixed promise of positive HOTA.
